text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: migration 'add_user_flags_v2' -> prod in change window 2026-03-20T21:00Z. Estimated exclusive lock: ~10s. Backfill per-shard estimate: 8-15m. Canary on 10% tenant traffic. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migrations/add_user_flags_v2 :thumbsup:

anya: reading the runbook now. quick q — does this create an index or just add column+backfill?

maya: column + backfill + unique index on (user_id, flag_key). index is CONCURRENT where possible, but we still need short exclusive PK lock for constraint check.

sam: FYI read-replica lag is 0-3s across regions. I'll keep a watch channel open.

lee: can we add a 5m pre-quiesce and a holdpoint at +5m after start? want to validate canary before full rollout. propose: quiesce signal 20:55Z, start migration 21:00Z, holdpoint 21:05Z.

anya: +1 to holdpoint. also add a version pin for the service schema client so no mixed writes during backfill. I'll PR a DB client pin.

sam: putting healthcheck alarm for 5xx and p50 latency > 2x baseline. will pause rollout if triggered.

maya: rollback plan documented: if constraint violation or high latency, we'll run the escape hatch to stop backfill and revert index creation step. SQL to revert index (if created):
```sql
-- rollback index (safe if created)
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS user_flags_userid_key_idx;
-- revert column changes if necessary (requires data migration rollback checklist)
```

lee: deploy-bot, request: pin service image tag to v2.14.1 for migration window.

deploy-bot: image pin applied to release group "user-service" -> v2.14.1, push confirmed.

ops-bot: canary run started at 21:01Z for tenant subset [t1,t2,t3].

sam: canary metrics so far: errors=0, p95 latency +3% (within threshold), backfill speed ~1200 rows/min.

anya: minor tweak to migration SQL to use IF NOT EXISTS on index create to avoid duplicate attempts across retries. PR posted: https://git.internal/r/redwood/migrations/pulls/452

maya: acked PR and merged. note: monitoring hook added to alert if backfill stalls > 2m.

lee: at holdpoint 21:05Z we'll confirm no replica lag spikes and canary success then continue. everyone on standby for rollback command.

sam: replica lag stable, health alarms clear.

ops-bot: canary passed at 21:07Z. proceeding to staged rollout -> 50% at 21:10Z.

maya: rolling to 50% now. watch for constraint check failures in logs: `constraint_violation: user_flags_key_unique`. if we see that, run rollback.

anya: noticed a small spike in write latency on one shard at 21:12Z, investigating.

sam: spike resolved after throttling burst traffic, no errors. continue.

deploy-bot: full rollout scheduled to finish by 21:30Z. final note: leave the index creation non-blocking where possible and annotate the schema change in release notes.

lee: recording post-check summary in release notes: added column user_flags.v2, backfill complete for 95% tenants, index created concurrently, no data integrity issues. will follow-up with detailed metrics tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks everyone. saving runbook state and closing channel after postmortem tomorrow if no issues.
